factual_and_methodological.summary: Current membership, institutional status and 2026 summit/trade facts are tied to official BRICS/NDB/Mercosur/EU sources; economic interpretation distinguishes institutions from political rhetoric.

editorial_publication_readiness.language_localization: EN/PT-BR fully localized and semantically aligned.
editorial_publication_readiness.cohesion: History, governance, asymmetry, finance/trade and 2026 implementation tests are connected.

contextual_depth.summary: Institutional history, governance design, member asymmetry, physical networks, financial mechanisms and current implementation are covered at the same structural standard used by the Russia dossier.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: Multiple tables and charts plus mindmap, causal flows and structural network map in both locales.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: Cross-country values are explicitly labelled and do not imply ranking or perfectly harmonized statistical definitions.

contrary_evidence: Institutional expansion is not treated as proof of economic integration.
Local-currency use is explicitly separated from claims of a common BRICS currency; Mercosur political durability is separated from incomplete market integration.
limitations: Membership, partner status and trade-agreement implementation are time-sensitive.
Intergovernmental declarations do not prove implementation without operational evidence.
notes: QA v2 reapproval binds the exact EN/PT-BR source blobs in 0cdfcca7e66e3bfbd6267bbfb8d6f9ccf793fab2; blocked internal editorial terminology was replaced by specific public-facing constraints without changing the substantive analysis.

en.title: Mercosur in 2026: from democratic rapprochement to an incomplete customs union facing its largest external opening
en.deck: A structural reconstruction of Mercosur as a political peace project, imperfect customs union, production network and external negotiating platform at the moment Bolivia is incorporated and the EU agreement enters provisional application.
en.regime: Mercosur remains an intergovernmental and incomplete customs union with durable political institutions; Bolivia's accession and the provisional EU agreement create the largest implementation test since its founding.
en.key_risk: If external liberalization advances without reducing internal customs, regulatory and infrastructure frictions, Mercosur may remain politically durable but economically shallow.

pt-BR.title: Mercosul em 2026: da aproximação democrática a uma união aduaneira incompleta diante de sua maior abertura externa
pt-BR.deck: Reconstrução estrutural do Mercosul como projeto político de paz, união aduaneira imperfeita, rede produtiva e plataforma de negociação externa no momento em que a Bolívia é incorporada e o acordo com a UE entra em aplicação provisória.
pt-BR.regime: O Mercosul permanece união aduaneira intergovernamental e incompleta com instituições políticas duráveis; a entrada da Bolívia e o acordo provisório com a UE criam o maior teste de implementação desde sua fundação.
pt-BR.key_risk: Se a abertura externa avançar sem reduzir fricções aduaneiras, regulatórias e de infraestrutura internas, o Mercosul pode permanecer politicamente durável mas economicamente raso.
